This disruption leads to a shared downstream effect on cellular processes that manifest as myopathy in Finnish upper limb-onset distal myopathy and Paget disease of bone in inclusion body myopathy with early-onset Paget disease with or without frontotemporal dementia 3.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in HNRNPA1 that are exclusively associated with one disease but not the other, or evidence that the functional consequences of the variants in the two diseases are mechanistically distinct (e.g., one is a loss-of-function and the other a gain-of-function) would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Presence of common benign variants in HNRNPA1 in gnomAD that do not segregate with either disease.)_
